i18n.locale: UI language when `@nuxtjs/i18n` is not enabled (e.g. `zh-CN`, `en`)
theme.blackAsPrimary: Use black as the primary color
theme.font: `editorial` uses serif headings, `sans` uses sans-serif everywhere
theme.grain: Overlay a paper grain texture on the page background
seo.titleTemplate: Page title template, with `%s` as the placeholder
seo.title: Default site title
header.title: Title shown in the header
header.to: Link target when clicking the title
header.links: Icon buttons on the right side of the header
header.nav: Top navigation links; `label` accepts a per-locale object and internal links get the locale prefix automatically
header.mobileNav: Navigation links in the mobile menu; falls back to the desktop navigation when empty
docs.categories: Group sidebar navigation by top-level directory; keys are directory slugs, values are category lists
footer.credits: Copyright text shown in the footer
footer.socials: Social link buttons shown in the footer
toc.title: Title of the table of contents; uses the built-in translation when empty
toc.bottom.title: Title of the area below the table of contents
toc.bottom.links: Link buttons shown below the table of contents
aside.filter.enabled: Show a navigation filter at the top of the sidebar
aside.filter.placeholder: Placeholder of the filter input; uses the built-in translation when empty
aside.filter.threshold: Show the filter only when the current group has at least this many items
aside.filter.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut that focuses the filter; empty disables it
github.name: GitHub repository name
github.rootDir: Root directory of the docs inside the repository
github.commitPath: Repository directory used by `CommitChangelog` to resolve component / composable source files
github.suffix: File extension, without the dot, used by `CommitChangelog` to resolve source files
github.since: Only fetch commits after this ISO date; empty means no limit
github.until: Only fetch commits before this ISO date; empty means no limit
github.perPage: Maximum number of commits fetched per file
github.author: Only show commits by this author
aiChat.floatingInput: Show the floating input at the bottom of docs pages
aiChat.explainWithAi: Show the "Explain with AI" button in the docs sidebar
aiChat.faqQuestions: Suggested questions; a string array, a categorized object array, or an object keyed by locale
aiChat.shortcuts.focusInput: Shortcut that focuses the floating input
aiChat.texts.title: Title of the AI chat panel
aiChat.texts.clearChat: Text of the clear chat button
aiChat.texts.lineBreak: Hint text for inserting a line break
aiChat.texts.trigger: Tooltip of the AI chat trigger button
aiChat.texts.explainWithAi: Text of the "Explain with AI" button
aiChat.icons.trigger: Icon of the AI chat trigger button
aiChat.icons.explain: Icon of the "Explain with AI" button
aiChat.icons.clearChat: Icon of the clear chat button
aiChat.icons.providers: Icons per AI provider; keys are provider names, values are icon names
